editorialSummary.heading: What Dallas ISD families should know about the Traditional Calendar
highlights: A two-day fall break before the October professional-development day
A continuous student no-class stretch from December 21 through January 5
Grade-specific parent conferences and early-release dates
paragraphs: Dallas ISD students on the Traditional Calendar start school Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and finish Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Fall break is October 8-9, followed by a professional-development day on Monday, October 12. Students are out from Thursday, October 8, through Monday, October 12, and return Tuesday, October 13. Thanksgiving break runs November 23-27.

Winter break runs December 21 through January 4. Students also have no classes January 5 for professional development and return Wednesday, January 6. Spring break is March 15-19, followed by a separate staff/student holiday on March 26. Dallas ISD also lists March 29 and April 19 as inclement weather days, so families should check district updates before making plans around those dates.

Early release works differently by grade level. Middle and high schools dismiss early December 16-17 and May 24-25, while all schools dismiss early December 18 and May 26. Parent conferences are also scheduled by school level: high school on October 19 and January 25, middle school on October 20 and January 26, and elementary school on October 22 and January 28.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school on the Dallas ISD Traditional Calendar for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of class is Tuesday, August 11, 2026, for students following Dallas ISD's Traditional Calendar. Students in the July-start ADSY schedule begin earlier, but ADSY dates depend on campus and grade.

faqs.question: What is the final student day for the Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: The last day of class is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. It is also an early-release day for every school, so families should confirm dismissal time with their campus.

faqs.question: Does Dallas ISD have a fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Thursday, October 8, and Friday, October 9. Monday, October 12, is a professional-development day with no classes, and students return Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break on the Dallas ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return to class Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: How long is winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: The official winter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. January 5 is a professional-development day, so students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: What week is Dallas ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Classes resume Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Which Dallas ISD dates are early-release days?
faqs.answer: Secondary schools dismiss early December 16-17, 2026, and May 24-25, 2027. All schools dismiss early December 18 and on the May 26 last day of class.

faqs.question: When are parent conferences for elementary, middle, and high schools?
faqs.answer: High school conferences are October 19 and January 25; middle school conferences are October 20 and January 26; elementary conferences are October 22 and January 28.

faqs.question: Which professional-development days occur after classes begin?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on October 12 and November 3, 2026, and January 5, 2027. August professional-development dates occur before the Traditional Calendar's first student day.

faqs.question: Is there school on November 3, 2026, in Dallas ISD?
faqs.answer: No. November 3 is a professional-development day with no student classes. Students return Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day in Dallas ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027, is listed as a staff/student holiday for Presidents Day, so there are no classes.

faqs.question: Why are Dallas ISD students off on March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: The Traditional Calendar marks Friday, March 26, as a staff/student holiday. It is a separate no-class day one week after spring break ends.

faqs.question: Are March 29 and April 19 regular school days?
faqs.answer: Dallas ISD labels both dates as inclement weather days. Their use can depend on weather closures or later district direction, so families should check current announcements before making plans.

faqs.question: When do the four nine-week grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The calendar's end markers fall on October 9 and December 18, 2026, then March 5 and May 26, 2027. October 9 is during fall break, and December 18 and May 26 are early-release days.

faqs.question: Which Dallas ISD calendar should my child follow?
faqs.answer: The Traditional Calendar begins August 11. The Early Start ADSY Calendar applies only to participating campuses and eligible grades. Students in the July-start ADSY schedule begin July 28, while Lida Hooe participates in Saturday School only. Families at ADSY campuses should confirm their child's schedule with the school.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official Dallas ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF link on this page for the Traditional Calendar, or open Dallas ISD's approved-calendars page to choose between the Traditional and ADSY documents.

editorialSummary.heading: How the 2026-2027 Early Start ADSY schedule works
highlights: A July 28 start at 12 elementary schools and for incoming sixth graders at seven middle schools
Ten summer weekdays before the Traditional Calendar begins
Five Saturday school dates for participating ADSY students
paragraphs: Early Start ADSY is not a districtwide calendar. Dallas ISD lists 13 elementary campuses, but Lida Hooe is Saturday School only; students at the other 12 elementary schools begin July 28. Incoming sixth graders at seven participating middle schools also begin July 28. The July 28 early start at those middle schools applies to incoming sixth graders, not seventh- or eighth-grade students.

Students with the July 28 ADSY start attend 10 summer weekdays before the Traditional Calendar begins: July 28-31, August 3-7, and August 10. Dallas ISD also schedules five Saturday school dates: September 12, October 17, November 14, January 9, and February 6. The ADSY calendar also marks Monday, December 14 as an instructional school day for the July-start ADSY schedule. The Traditional Calendar is also in session that day; Lida Hooe is Saturday School only.

Dallas ISD says students receive meals during the additional ADSY days, eligible students receive transportation, and after-school programs are available. Because ADSY participation depends on campus and grade, families should confirm enrollment and daily schedules with their school.

faqs.question: What does ADSY mean in Dallas ISD?
faqs.answer: ADSY stands for Additional Days School Year. Dallas ISD's Early Start program gives participating students additional learning time before the regular school year and on selected Saturdays. The July early start applies only to the campuses and grades identified by the district.

faqs.question: Which Dallas ISD schools participate in Early Start ADSY in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Dallas ISD lists 13 elementary campuses: J. N. Ervin, John Q. Adams, José “Joe” May, Lee A. McShan Jr., Marcus Leadership Academy, H. S. Thompson, John Neely Bryan, Lida Hooe, Julian T. Saldivar, Ronald McNair, Birdie Alexander, Frank Guzick and Harrell Budd. Lida Hooe is Saturday School only. Incoming sixth graders also participate at Harold Wendell Lang Sr., Young Men's Leadership Academy at Fred F. Florence, Boude Storey, Sam Tasby, Royce West Leadership Academy, T. W. Browne and Hector P. Garcia middle schools.

faqs.question: When does the Dallas ISD ADSY school year begin?
faqs.answer: The July-start ADSY schedule begins Tuesday, July 28, 2026, for students at 12 participating elementary schools and incoming sixth graders at seven middle schools. Lida Hooe participates in Saturday School only.

faqs.question: Which summer dates are included before the traditional school year starts?
faqs.answer: The 10 summer weekdays are July 28-31, August 3-7, and August 10. The July 28-August 10 span includes two weekends, which are not class days.

faqs.question: What are the five ADSY Saturday school dates?
faqs.answer: Saturday school is scheduled for September 12, October 17, and November 14, 2026, plus January 9 and February 6, 2027. These dates apply to participating ADSY students.

faqs.question: Why is December 14 marked on the ADSY Calendar?
faqs.answer: Monday, December 14, 2026, is marked as an ADSY instructional school day for students in the July-start ADSY schedule. The Traditional Calendar is also in session that Monday. Lida Hooe participates in Saturday School only.

faqs.question: Do seventh- and eighth-grade students at ADSY middle schools start July 28?
faqs.answer: No. Dallas ISD says the July 28 early start at the seven participating middle schools is for incoming sixth graders. Seventh- and eighth-grade students do not follow that early-start schedule.

faqs.question: Does Lida Hooe follow the July early-start schedule?
faqs.answer: No. Dallas ISD lists Lida Hooe Elementary as Saturday School only, so the July 28-August 10 summer schedule does not apply there.

faqs.question: What do students do during Dallas ISD ADSY additional days?
faqs.answer: Dallas ISD says ADSY days include reading and math, enrichment, teamwork and activities designed to build students' connection to school. Saturday sessions use themed activities. For participating sixth graders, the district lists 180 minutes of reading and math, 150 minutes of enrichment, and 90 minutes of group huddles or club activities during additional days.

faqs.question: When do ADSY students finish the 2026-2027 school year?
faqs.answer: The final class day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. All schools dismiss early that day, so families should get the exact release time from their campus.

faqs.question: Does the Dallas ISD ADSY Calendar have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. ADSY students have fall break October 8-9, 2026. October 12 is a professional-development day with no student classes, so students return Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Do ADSY students get the same Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Yes. The ADSY Calendar shows Thanksgiving break from Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026, with classes returning November 30.

faqs.question: When do ADSY students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs December 21 through January 4. January 5 is a professional-development day with no classes, so students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

faqs.question: Is ADSY spring break different from the Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: No. The ADSY PDF lists spring break for March 15-19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22, and have a separate staff/student holiday on March 26.

faqs.question: Which ADSY dates have early dismissal?
faqs.answer: ADSY students at participating middle schools have early release December 16-17, 2026, and May 24-25, 2027. ADSY elementary students do not have those secondary-only early-release dates. All ADSY campuses dismiss early December 18 and May 26.

faqs.question: Are meals and transportation available on additional ADSY days?
faqs.answer: Dallas ISD says all participating students receive school meals during additional days, eligible students receive transportation, and after-school programs are available. Confirm the local arrangements with your campus.

faqs.question: What happens on the ADSY inclement weather dates?
faqs.answer: March 29 and April 19 are labeled inclement weather days. Whether students attend can depend on closures and later district guidance, so check Dallas ISD announcements before those dates.

faqs.question: Where is the official Dallas ISD ADSY calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Use the official ADSY PDF link on this page. The Dallas ISD approved-calendars page also links both the ADSY document and the separate Traditional Calendar.
